tail:
No fatal or nonfatal defect found in the 13 assigned items.

Key checks completed:

- Recomputed every displayed list, Kleisli composite, flattening, and formal-sum value; all are correct.
- Writer multiplication preserves the order \(mnp\), uses the identity \(e\), and requires no commutativity.
- State unit and multiplication have consistent pair order; both associativity composites thread the same three states. The empty-state case is valid.
- Interior monotonicity and idempotence follow from `[L1]`’s repaired clauses alone. Closure and interior both handle \(\varnothing\) and the empty ambient space correctly.
- Checked all four distributive-law axioms. Their component arrows have the required common endpoints, and thinness makes them equal. The eight displayed composite values are correct.
- For finite \(X\), \(\beta X=\{\eta_X(x):x\in X\}\), hence \(|\beta X|=|X|\), including \(X=\varnothing\) and singleton \(X\). The infinite contrast is correctly conditional on the ultrafilter lemma.
- The two-element idempotent monoid is associative and cannot be free: rank \(0\) gives one element, while every positive rank gives infinitely many words.
- The group coequalizer is \(\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z\); the Set coequalizer has one even class and singleton odd classes, so it is genuinely different.
- The double contravariant power-set functor is covariant after two inverse-image applications. Its unit and multiplication have the stated types and formulas; naturality and the monad laws are licensed by the cited adjunction theorem, not merely asserted. The formulas also agree with the cited [Riehl treatment](https://emilyriehl.github.io/files/context.pdf).
- No assigned item depends on an `ai-generated` Statement or Construction.

Coverage: I read all 13 assigned items fully, the B-page manifest, and all 37 direct dependency files on disk. I sampled no items and left nothing unchecked. The item hashes remained unchanged during the review.
